scope: bounded primary full-text scope comparison; no universal claim that the complete literature has been searched

items.scope_read: Sections1–3 and Theorem3.1; single Brownian cover-time transform on a circle, including standard two-endpoint Laplace exit transforms. Not a competing first-arrival partition or its joint length law.

Introduction and main Theorems1.1/1.2; construction, uniqueness and cover-time bound for a single Brownian motion on graph-like spaces. No finite-k first-arrival territory transform in these main claims.

Supplement ModelI.D.1, equationS53, FigureS1a1/a2 and discussion of S45/S46, printed7–8; geometric Voronoi cells of instantaneous circular Brownian positions, with limiting beta/gamma spacing laws. Ownership is determined by nearest current position, rather than the earliest visit of a continuing particle.

Printed064104-1 through064104-4, especially equations8–11; the complete multitime law of a single one-dimensional walker’s visited span, using independent successive exit increments. Related standard mechanism, different observable and no competition among finite-k walkers on the circle.
